utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! We're having a repair drive this Saturday at the community center. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it from Vik. Count me in—I can help with fixing things around the center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Dane! See you Saturday at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Nell. Do you know the exact time for the repair drive? I need to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure of the exact time, Eli. Rosa mentioned it's on Saturday at the community center, but I can check with her and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be great, Nell. I'd appreciate if you could confirm the exact time. I like to have my schedule set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Kira, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm also coordinating a pickup for items on Tuesday if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who's actually organizing that? I haven't seen any official notice.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I thought the word was out. It's a community thing—I'm helping coordinate the pickup. It's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer... or was that last month?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. We could use some extra hands—do you have any spare screws or solder?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Screws? I think I have some in the garage... unless I used them for that shelf. I'll check.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hey Vik, I'm a bit worried about the supplies for the repair drive. Do you know if everything's accounted for?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think Rey said we need nails and lumber for the fences, and I'm bringing my old blender, but not sure about tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Tools are crucial — do we have enough hammers and saws? I'm worried we'll be scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Hana, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I've heard a bit about it, but could you fill me in on the specific details? What exactly needs repairing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's going to be great! They're fixing up bikes and small appliances—like toasters, lamps, that sort of thing. Starts at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you thinking of joining the repair drive, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think so, but I can't remember the time... was it 10 or 11?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's at 10 on Saturday. I've got it marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, is the repair drive still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it's still on for Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. Are you planning to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I've got a broken lamp I've been meaning to fix. I'll try to drop by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thanks for the update! So it's Sunday at the community center now. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it starts at 10 AM. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, 10 AM it is! I'll mark my calendar. Thanks Jules!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the parts for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I have everything ready. Just a reminder, it's now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, Sunday works. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rey, could you help me with my fence during the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, Uli. I can help with your fence. Do you need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I've got hammers and nails, but a level would be great if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, have you heard any updates about the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No updates yet, but I'm ready with tools whenever you need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know you're ready, Gus. I'll keep an ear out for any news.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. Tools would be great! I'm bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any specific tools for that blender? I've got screwdrivers and wrenches if you need to open it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do you know if we still need nails and lumber for the fences?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure, Rey. I was actually about to ask Jules for more details on what exactly needs to be repaired. Have you heard anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No, I haven't heard specifics either. Maybe we can ask Jules together?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'm set on tools. Just bring broken items Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Leo! See you Saturday with your tools and some broken items.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, are you all set for the repair drive? Need any help getting your stuff together?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I'm almost ready—just checking the materials list with Cleo. Could you grab a few extra screwdrivers from your garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll grab a few from my garage. Do you need any specific sizes?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, you heard about the repair drive we're organizing? We could really use a hand gathering broken items from folks around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure that's a thing? Who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's a community thing! I'm helping organize it. We're collecting broken household items to fix up instead of trashing them. Want to help gather stuff from neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, checking online sounds good. Thanks, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You're welcome, Bo. I think it's at the community center, but I'm not sure about the time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I'll just pop by Saturday morning then. Thanks again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Nell! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's a community event where we fix up bikes and small appliances for free! Mara's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community center and playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I'd love to help out! What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We're starting at 9 AM at the community center. Can you bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? Want to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Yes, I think I have some flyers somewhere... just need to find them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Oren! Let me know if you need help rounding up people or anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm so glad you can make it! We'll be starting at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Perfect, I'll be there at 10. Thanks for organizing this, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You're very welcome, Uli! I'm excited to see everyone come together to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'll be there. It starts at 10 AM sharp, as always.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great! Do you have any items that need pickup on Tuesday before the drive?
